meta.name: use-native-credential-proxy
meta.description: Opt out of the OneCLI gateway and supply Anthropic credentials from .env instead. For users who want simple .env-based credential management without the OneCLI agent vault. Reads the API key or OAuth token from .env and injects it into the container's API requests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从.env文件读取凭证并注入API请求
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果不想用OneCLI网关，想用简单的.env管理凭证
copy.tagline_en: Read credentials from .env and inject into API requests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want simple .env-based credential management without the OneCLI agent vault

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会直接从宿主机的 .env 文件读取 Anthropic 凭证（API 密钥或 OAuth 令牌），并注入到容器环境变量中，不再经过 OneCLI 网关。
howto.when: 当 .env 文件中设置 NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true 且提供了 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY、CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN 等凭证时触发。

say.text: 我想用 Claude Pro 订阅，帮我配置凭证。
帮我设置 Anthropic API 密钥到 .env。
say.note: 技能会添加 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY 并启用标志。

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude reads Anthropic credentials (API key or OAuth token) directly from the host's .env file and injects them into the container environment variables, bypassing the OneCLI gateway.
howto.when_en: Triggered when NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true is set in .env and at least one credential (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, etc.) is provided.

say_en.text: Check if NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true is set in .env.
say_en.note: The skill reads this flag to enable native credential proxy.

say_en.text: I want to use my Claude Pro subscription, help me configure credentials.
say_en.note: The skill guides to run claude setup-token and set CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN.

say_en.text: Set my Anthropic API key in .env.
say_en.note: The skill adds ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and enables the flag.
